_purpose: Independently-authored ground truth for run_scenario.py. These values were reasoned from the fixtures BY HAND, not generated by the pipeline — a reviewer can read scenario_a.json / scenario_b.json and confirm each expectation without running anything. run_scenario.py asserts the pipeline reproduces them. final_sha256 additionally pins byte-for-byte reproducibility.
_property_invariants: P1: every surviving finding has a specific citable provenance (no vague placeholder)
P2: no adversarially-refuted key remains in findings
P3: coverage.state 'complete' implies zero blocked agents and empty residual_frontier
P4: every conflict is preserved as >=2 variants — never averaged or blended
P5: the final object carries human_review_required: true
P6: the run is deterministic — two runs produce byte-identical output
P7: no fabrication — every surviving finding key came from a validated agent envelope
P8: the uncitable/malformed envelope is rejected and its finding never survives
P9: agents cannot self-spawn — a recursive wave without human approval halts the run and surfaces a recommendation instead of spawning (P7 ties every finding to a dispatched, approved agent)

A._reasoning: PM+CA+SA+IA validate (BAD rejected: provenance 'internal' is uncitable). AO reported by PM(high), CA(medium), IA(high) -> merged, confidence floored to medium. SCA(high), ISSO(high) merge cleanly. REL is a conflict (CA 'Superset' vs SA 'Equal') and DEV is low-confidence, so both are pending_verification. Skeptics refute REL (3-1) -> removed to failed_to_merge; skeptics confirm DEV (3-1) -> stays. PM's 'IA family' lead is covered in wave 2, so residual reconciles to empty and, with no blocks, coverage is complete. Frontier dries in wave 2 and the judge is satisfied -> stop 'saturated'.

B._reasoning: PM completes; BROKEN is blocked with no lead. The frontier is dry after one wave, but the judge is unsatisfied (coverage 0.5) — the loop cannot invent leads, so it stops as 'frontier_exhausted' and records the unmet quality bar in residual_uncertainty. One blocked agent forces coverage 'partial'. AO is high-confidence with no conflict, so nothing is pending verification.

C._reasoning: Identical to A through wave 1, but wave 2 (the residual 'IA family' lead) is NOT human-approved. Agents cannot self-spawn, so the loop halts 'awaiting_human_approval' and surfaces the manager's recommendation (proposed_scopes ['IA family']) rather than dispatching it. Only wave 1 runs, so wave-2 findings (ISSO) never appear. AO is PM(high)+CA(medium) -> medium; REL still refuted; the un-dispatched 'IA family' lead stays in residual_frontier, so coverage is 'partial'.
